principal.name: Dr. Manjunath T N
principal.title: Principal
principal.profile: Dr. Manjunath T N leads SVIT with the motto 'Learn to Lead,' focusing on academic excellence, innovation, and student success. Under his leadership, SVIT emphasizes industry-aligned engineering and management education with strong links to VTU affiliation, AICTE recognition, NAAC 'A' grade, and NBA-accredited programs. He highlights student-centric teaching, dedicated faculty, and strong support for co-curricular activities and placements to make students industry-ready. His vision is to develop technically skilled, innovative, and socially responsible leaders who can navigate complexity with wisdom and humility. Through encouragement of research, internships, and entrepreneurship, he aims to transform students' aspirations into real achievements.

cse.hod_bio: With extensive teaching and research experience in core computer science, Dr. Shashikumar D R leads the CSE department with a strong focus on fundamentals and industry-oriented learning. He has guided multiple student projects, promotes coding culture and hackathons, and actively works on curriculum enhancement aligned with emerging technologies. His areas of interest span algorithms, software engineering, and modern computing practices.

cse_aiml.hod_title: Professor & HOD, CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
cse_aiml.hod_bio: Dr. T G Manjunatha heads the AIML department, emphasizing solid foundations in AI, machine learning, and data-driven problem solving. He has significant academic and research experience, guiding projects that apply AI techniques to real-world applications. Under his leadership, the department conducts workshops, coding events, and hands-on sessions to build strong practical skills.

cse_ds.hod_bio: With 20 years of experience, Dr. Nagashree N holds a Ph.D. from Visvesvaraya Technological University and specializes in Data Science, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. She has over 35 publications in international journals and conferences, reflecting strong research contributions. As HOD of CSE (Data Science), she leads initiatives that blend theory with practical analytics and AI applications for real-world problems.

ise.hod_bio: Dr. Amogh Pramod Kulkarni is the Head of the ISE & CSE (Cyber Security) Departments at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with over 16 years of teaching and research experience. His expertise includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing, with active involvement in research, academic leadership, technical training, and student development.

ece.hod_bio: Dr. Venkatesha M heads the ECE department, focusing on core electronics, communication systems, and embedded technologies. He has many years of academic experience and actively supports student participation in hardware projects and research. His work spans VLSI, communication networks, and applied electronics.

civil.hod_bio: Dr. Ananthayya M B leads the Civil Engineering department with emphasis on structural, environmental, and construction engineering. He has considerable teaching and field experience, encouraging students to engage in practical design and site-related learning. His academic interests cover core civil domains and sustainable infrastructure.

mechanical.hod_bio: Dr. Raghavendra S heads the Mechanical Engineering department, focusing on design, manufacturing, and thermal engineering. He has strong academic and research exposure and supports project-based learning, labs, and industry interaction. His interests include advanced manufacturing and applied mechanics.

mba.hod_title: Professor & HOD, Master of Business Administration (MBA)
mba.hod_bio: Dr. Jogish D leads the MBA department, integrating management education with practical exposure to industry practices. He has experience in teaching, training, and consultancy, guiding students towards careers in business, analytics, and entrepreneurship. His interests span marketing, strategy, and organizational development.

mathematics.hod_bio: Dr. Arun Kumar R heads the Mathematics department, ensuring strong mathematical foundations for all engineering disciplines. He has extensive teaching experience and focuses on applied mathematics relevant to engineering and data analysis. His work supports advanced courses and research that rely on rigorous quantitative skills.

physics.hod_bio: Dr. Shankar P leads the Physics department, concentrating on engineering physics and fundamental science education. He emphasizes conceptual clarity and experimental skills through well-designed laboratory work. His interests include materials, electronics-related physics, and applied physical sciences.

chemistry.hod_bio: Dr. Bhagya N P heads the Chemistry department, teaching engineering chemistry and its applications in materials and environmental domains. She has strong academic experience and promotes lab-based learning to connect theory with practice. Her interests lie in applied chemistry relevant to engineering and industry processes.

cse_cysec.hod_bio: Dr. Amogh Pramod Kulkarni is the Head of the ISE & CSE (Cyber Security) Departments at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with over 16 years of teaching and research experience. His expertise includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing, with active involvement in research, academic leadership, technical training, and student development.

cse_bs.hod_bio: Dr. Prasanna Lakshmi G S is the Head of the CSE (Business Systems) Department at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with over 15 years of teaching and research experience. Her expertise spans Cybersecurity, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Big Data, with significant contributions to research, innovation, patents, and academic development.

cse.name: Computer Science & Engineering
cse.intro: The Computer Science & Engineering department leads the digital revolution with a cutting-edge curriculum. We transform students into top-tier software developers and system architects.
cse.hod_voice: Led by Dr. Shashikumar D R, our vision focuses on industry-driven learning tailored for global demands. We prioritize hands-on problem solving and ethical coding practices.
cse.achievements: Our labs are state-of-the-art, ensuring strong VTU rankings and continuous success in national hackathons.
cse.placement: Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, and Amazon. Students receive rigorous technical and aptitude training.
cse.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹3,50,000/year

cse_aiml.name: CSE (AI & ML)
cse_aiml.intro: The AI & Machine Learning department pioneers the future of intelligent systems. We prepare innovators for the rapidly evolving tech landscape.
cse_aiml.hod_voice: Guided by Dr. T G Manjunatha, we emphasize a NEP-2020 compliant curriculum enriched with deep learning and real-world AI applications.
cse_aiml.achievements: Our 2021 batch secured FOUR university ranks at the VTU level, showcasing our academic rigor and student excellence.
cse_aiml.placement: Students gain hands-on experience through stipend-based internships and targeted workshops with industry experts.
cse_aiml.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹3,50,000/year

cse_ds.name: CSE (Data Science)
cse_ds.intro: Data Science is the backbone of modern analytics. We equip students with scientific methods to extract knowledge from complex data.
cse_ds.hod_voice: Dr. Nagashree N directs our commitment to generate knowledge through state-of-the-art concepts and rigorous analytical training.
cse_ds.achievements: Since starting in 2021, our students have already secured THREE university ranks at the VTU level.
cse_ds.placement: We foster strong connections with analytics firms, ensuring our graduates are ready for high-demand data roles.
cse_ds.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹3,00,000/year

cse_cysec.name: CSE (Cyber Security)
cse_cysec.intro: The Cyber Security department trains the frontline defenders of the digital age. We focus on secure systems and defensive computing.
cse_cysec.hod_voice: Dr. Amogh Pramod Kulkarni is the Head of the ISE & CSE (Cyber Security) Departments at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with over 16 years of teaching and research experience. His expertise includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing, with active involvement in research, academic leadership, technical training, and student development.
cse_cysec.achievements: We maintain active collaborations with cybersecurity centers of excellence to keep our curriculum highly relevant.
cse_cysec.placement: Graduates are highly sought after by top IT firms and specialized security agencies worldwide.
cse_cysec.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹3,25,000/year

cse_bs.name: CSE (Business Systems)
cse_bs.intro: Bridging technology and enterprise strategy, the Business Systems department creates the next generation of tech-savvy business leaders.
cse_bs.hod_voice: Dr. Prasanna Lakshmi G S is the Head of the CSE (Business Systems) Department at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with over 15 years of teaching and research experience. Her expertise spans Cybersecurity, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Big Data, with significant contributions to research, innovation, patents, and academic development.
cse_bs.achievements: Our students excel in cross-disciplinary projects, creating software that solves real-world corporate challenges.
cse_bs.placement: Consulting and tech firms actively recruit our graduates for roles bridging engineering and enterprise management.
cse_bs.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹2,75,000/year

ise.name: Information Science
ise.intro: Information Science focuses on applied computing and software engineering aligned directly with current industry needs.
ise.hod_voice: Dr. Amogh Pramod Kulkarni is the Head of the ISE & CSE (Cyber Security) Departments at Sai Vidya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with over 16 years of teaching and research experience. His expertise includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Big Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing, with active involvement in research, academic leadership, technical training, and student development.
ise.achievements: Our dedicated faculty ensures project-based learning, entrepreneurial thinking, and ethical technical development.
ise.placement: Consistent placements in leading IT service and product companies, supported by strong alumni networking.
ise.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹2,50,000/year

ece.name: Electronics & Communication
ece.intro: ECE is the cornerstone of modern hardware and communication systems, offering deep expertise from VLSI to High-Speed Networks.
ece.hod_voice: Dr. Venkatesha M leads our NBA-accredited department, fostering research in Embedded Systems, Photonics, and Signal Processing.
ece.achievements: Supported by over 70 Lakhs in research grants, our state-of-the-art labs feature industry tools like Cadence and MATLAB.
ece.placement: We run dedicated Centers of Excellence in 5G and IoT, directly connecting students to top tech manufacturers and research labs.
ece.fees: KCET: As per KEA norms | Management: ₹2,00,000/year

civil.name: Civil Engineering
civil.intro: Civil Engineering shapes the infrastructure of tomorrow. We build sustainable engineers who design and innovate for the future.
civil.hod_voice: Dr. Ananthayya M B guides our mission to transform students into frontrunners and guardians of natural resources.
civil.achievements: Established in 2010, the department boasts experienced faculty deeply involved in R&D and core structural engineering.
civil.placement: Strong alumni network in reputed global construction and consultancy industries provides excellent career opportunities.
civil.fees: KCET: ₹1,10,000/year | Management: Priority CET-FEES as per KEA

mechanical.name: Mechanical Engineering
mechanical.intro: Mechanical Engineering is the bedrock of industrial innovation. We instill global competency through practical, ethical education.
mechanical.hod_voice: Under Dr. Raghavendra S, we create technologically superior global manpower through active industry participation and R&D.
mechanical.achievements: Our well-equipped labs and dedicated researchers provide hands-on technical skill enhancement with modern tools.
mechanical.placement: Core manufacturing and automotive companies actively recruit our skilled, industry-ready graduates.
mechanical.fees: KCET: ₹1,10,000/year | Management: Priority CET-FEES as per KEA

mba.name: Master of Business Administration
mba.intro: Our MBA program empowers students with the knowledge, skills, and values needed for holistic corporate development.
mba.hod_voice: Led by Dr. Jogish D, boasting 25+ years of experience, we master Specializations across Finance, HR, IT, and Marketing.
mba.achievements: Our modern management laboratories and experienced full-time faculty drive premier business education and alumni success.
mba.placement: Comprehensive career guidance places our postgraduates in leading global corporations across diverse business sectors.
mba.fees: Total Course (2 Years): General ₹1,55,000 - ₹3,10,000 | Core Specializations ₹1,40,000

basic_sciences.name: Basic Sciences
basic_sciences.intro: The Basic Sciences departments—Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry—provide the essential scientific and analytical foundation for all engineers.
basic_sciences.hod_voice: Headed by Dr. Arun Kumar R, Dr. Shankar P, and Dr. Bhagya N P, we promote mathematical thinking, applied chemistry, and fundamental physics.
basic_sciences.achievements: Recognized as VTU Research Centres, our faculty continuously publish research findings in peer-reviewed international journals.
basic_sciences.placement: A strong first-year foundation ensures all SVIT engineers excel in aptitude and logical reasoning throughout their careers.
basic_sciences.fees: Integrated seamlessly across the first-year engineering curriculum.

events.sanchalana.title: SANCHALANA
points: SVIT's flagship inter-collegiate cultural fest.
Dance, music, theater, fashion and fine arts.
Celebrity acts, DJ nights and stage events.
events.sanchalana.tts_summary: Sanchalana is SVIT's flagship inter-collegiate cultural fest with dance, music, theater, fashion and fine arts, plus celebrity acts and DJ nights.

events.techvidya.title: TECHVIDYA
points: Promotes innovation and practical engineering skills.
Hackathons, coding marathons and robotics challenges.
Paper presentations, circuit debugging and quizzes.
events.techvidya.tts_summary: Techvidya is SVIT's annual technical fest with hackathons, coding marathons, robotics challenges, paper presentations and technical quizzes.

events.sangama.title: SANGAMA
points: SVIT's year-round cultural club and platform.
Talent hunts, music jams and traditional days.
Prepares students for larger fests like Sanchalana.
events.sangama.tts_summary: Sangama is SVIT's year-round cultural club, with talent hunts and music jams, preparing students for larger fests like Sanchalana.

events.vignotsava.title: VIGNOTSAVA
points: Campus celebration around Onam and Ganesha Chaturthi.
Pookalam competitions and cultural processions.
Traditional music, dance and ethnic attire.
events.vignotsava.tts_summary: Vignotsava is a campus celebration around Onam and Ganesha Chaturthi, with Pookalam competitions, processions and traditional music and dance.

events.project_expo.title: PROJECT EXPO
points: Final-year students showcase capstone projects.
Industry leaders, academics and alumni evaluate.
Top projects get recognition or incubation support.
events.project_expo.tts_summary: Project Expo is where final-year students showcase capstone projects. Industry leaders, academics and alumni evaluate them, with top projects earning recognition or incubation support.
